name: search
description: Semantic and keyword search across the user's knowledge — everything an agent wrote and every document ingested; returns the most relevant passages for a natural-language query.

name: grep
description: Exact substring / regex search across knowledge files; use when the user wants a literal string or pattern, not semantic relevance.

name: read
description: Read one specific knowledge entry or ingested document by its id.

name: list
description: List the knowledge scopes, or the contents of one scope.

name: write
description: Persist a new entry, or update an existing one, in a knowledge scope.

name: delete
description: Delete one knowledge entry or ingested document by its id.

name: list_skills
description: List the skills currently available to load.

name: load_skill
description: Load a specific named skill's full instructions into context.
